Key true: double tagging works only when the attacker's VLAN is the trunk's native VLAN (10.5.3; IEEE 802.1Q sends the native VLAN untagged). The comment «функция двойного тегирования VLAN работает, даже если магистральные порты отключены» is false: the attack needs a trunk; only the attacker's port need not be one. «Native», «нативной VLAN», «режим магистрали»: «собственная VLAN», «режим магистрального канала».

Key 7 matches the exhibit by the module's rule (AS3 toward the server, DS1 and DS2 toward AS3, two uplinks each on AS1 and AS2). The lecture's «Address4 … используется только в режиме ad hoc» is false (an IBSS frame uses three addresses); listed for a lecture change. Shared comment restates the key.

Recall item (12.3.7: active scanning is needed when beacons are off). Shared comment restates the key.

Recall item. «переключает локальный трафик» mistranslates local switching (the lecture: «локальная коммутация»). The combined comment explains both modes.

Pure recall (FHSS, 12.5.1); q04 is the lecture's allowed recall item. Key true. Shared comment restates the key; it should say DSSS spreads each bit over a wide band and OFDM/OFDMA use orthogonal subcarriers.

Pure recall (OFDMA, 12.5.1). Distractor «OFDM» is also true: 802.11ax (IEEE 802.11ax-2021, clause 27 HE PHY) is an OFDM PHY that adds OFDMA for multi-user access, and the lecture itself calls OFDMA «разновидность OFDM». «новом стандарте» is stale. Shared comment restates the key.
The one allowed recall item; key true (13 channels in Europe, ETSI EN 300 328). The shared comment explains 11 and 14 but not that 24 is the lecture's 5 GHz count.
